parts.label: (b)
parts.stem:
Antidiuretic hormone (ADH) is involved in the maintenance of the water potential of the blood.
Fig. 8.2 shows the relationship between blood ADH concentration, urine concentration and the flow rate of urine.
The flow rate of urine is the rate of production of urine by the kidneys.
{{figure:figure_8_2.webp}}
Fig. 8.2
parts.text: Describe the relationships shown in Fig. 8.2.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Describe **and** explain the action of ADH on the cells of the collecting duct when the water potential of the blood decreases.
